Nora - CSM: Quick heads up — Northpeak private/VPC onboarding hit three small but blocking items during smoke test: egress port restrictions, KMS key ACL, and missing audit log routing. Capturing here and assigning owners.
Ethan - Solutions Eng: Can you paste the error we see in the agent?
Nora - CSM: Agent: `2026-03-22T14:07:12Z WARN dial tcp 10.4.5.6:443: connect: connection refused` when attempting to POST to our ingest endpoint.
Sora - Infra: That looks like their NAT/firewall. Their infra team has TGW egress rules limited to 443 only to some destinations. Our forwarder IPs use ephemeral ports for responses. We either ask them to SNAT through a NAT GW we list, or widen ephemeral outbound (1024-65535) to our forwarder CIDR.
June - Customer Ops: Northpeak prefers to change rules during their maintenance window Sun 0200-0300 UTC. They want a quick validation plan.
Ethan - Solutions Eng: Plan: (1) customer applies rule, (2) we spin a debug pod and run `curl -v https://ingest.northpeak.redwood-infer.test/health` and `echo test | openssl s_client -connect ingest...` to validate TLS. I'll run during their window.
Diego - Security: KMS note: their onboarding key policy currently denies `kms:GenerateDataKey` to our service role. We need that for envelope encryption. Minimal policy snippet I suggest below; they can scope Resource to the alias if they want.
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodOnboard",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWN:role/redwood-service-role" },
      "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Nora - CSM: They asked for the absolute minimum. Diego, can you add a copy with Condition limiting to the onboarding alias so they can paste it?
Diego - Security: Sure, will DM a restricted version. ETA today EOD.
Sora - Infra: Audit logs: their Fluentd forwarder shows connection attempts but the ELB terminates with `TLS alert: unknown ca`. Customer said they're using an internal PKI and will upload the chain to the secure vault. If we don't get a chain we can allow a temporary insecure test endpoint for smoke.
June - Customer Ops: Northpeak will upload cert chain to the vault by Sat 22:00 UTC. They requested we not keep any cert artifacts longer than 72 hours.
Ethan - Solutions Eng: Action owners and ETAs:
- Sora: confirm SNAT option and validate ephemeral port reachability (ETA Sun 0300 UTC)
- Diego: post restricted KMS policy snippet (ETA today EOD)
- Ethan: run TLS + health checks during customer window and report results (ETA Sun 0330 UTC)
- June: confirm cert in vault and retention TTL (ETA Sat 22:00 UTC)
June - Customer Ops: Noted. Also passing along renewal note from account team: if onboarding completes this month, they sign the reserved-capacity addendum. If delayed > 10 business days, renewal conversation gets elevated. Marking as "watch" for renewal health.
Nora - CSM: I'll mark renewal-risk = medium and add customer comment to healthboard. Also logging retrospective items: add a KMS policy example to the runbook, and a short SNAT FAQ for customer quickstarts.
onboard-bot: Ticket updated: ONB-9092 items added: `egress_rules`, `kms_acl`, `audit_cert`. See runbook/priv-onboard-checklist for steps.
Diego - Security: Small follow-up: ask Northpeak to rotate the KMS key alias after tests and then share the new alias; we'll re-tighten access to just the new alias. Low effort, reduces long-term exposure.
Sora - Infra: If TLS still fails after cert chain upload, we may need them to enable TLSv1.2+ ciphers we support. I'll DM cipher list.
Ethan - Solutions Eng: Also adding non-blocking optimization item: once live, enable prefix caching for their high-volume embed routes to reduce tokens and decrease cost for them — useful talking point for renewal.
June - Customer Ops: Customer expects a final test confirmation by Mon 0600 UTC. I'll nudge them pre-window. :raising_hand:
Nora - CSM: Thanks all — I'll keep this thread updated with test evidence and the renewal note.
